author: Bobby Grayson
description: Substitute the init parameter(s) by the spawn-argument AST, then hand the bound expression to state_expr/4 in the parent's environment. Type-directed rendering works for both identity and non-identity init; the parent's own aliases (e.g. pid bound to fresh) still apply. Postwalk, not prewalk, so a substituted argument is not re-substituted.
title: Chosen: bind init parameter at AST level via Macro.postwalk, then existing type-directed state_expr in parent env
